notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0 New Maze Level
notes.content:
A new level with by far the largest maze of the game has been added. Each level has its own music and this new level has a soundtrack over 25 minutes long. Since it is now the current final level you will still have to pass the previous levels to reach it. It is sure to bring you a challenge.

The main menu music has been changed as well.

notes.title: Mazing Mad Released!
notes.content: I'm happy to bring Mazing Mad to you all and hope that you will enjoy it. If you encounter any problems please feel free to report it, or if you have any suggestions or ideas, I would love to hear about it. The plan now is bug fixes and additional content. Enjoy
